title: 5 Best Legal AI Tools for Am Law and Large Law Firms in 2027
summary: Compare the 5 best legal AI tools for Am Law and large law firms in 2027, with AI features, integrations, pricing and AI ROI.
body_markdown:
### AI Summary


-


AI timekeeping at large firms now competes on three things: capture accuracy, compliance with Outside Counsel Guidelines at the point of entry, and fit with Elite 3E, Aderant or Intapp.


-


Research AI is starting to feed time systems: Harvey now creates draft entries in Aderant iTimekeep, and Legora sends work data to Intapp Time.


-


The tools split into AI built into your financial platform (Intapp Time, Aderant iTimekeep, Elite) and AI platforms that sit on top of it (PointOne, Laurel).


-


All five use custom enterprise pricing. Compare them on recovered revenue, realization and review hours saved.


## What Legal AI Tools Do Enterprise Law Firms Typically Use?


Legal AI tools are software products that use AI to do legal work or run the business of a law firm. At an AmLaw 100 firm they fall into four types:


-


**Legal research AI:** answers research questions and summarizes case law, for example Lexis+ AI and Westlaw CoCounsel.


-


**Drafting and document AI:** drafts and reviews documents and analyzes files, for example Harvey, Legora and Microsoft Copilot.


-


**Contract review and e-discovery AI:** reviews agreements and sorts discovery documents at volume.


-


**Billables AI:** turns a firm's work data into time entries, narratives and codes, applies Outside Counsel Guidelines, reviews pre-bills and reports on capacity, pricing and AI use.


### Research AI Now Feeds Time Capture


The line between practice AI and business AI is closing. In August 2026, Harvey and Aderant announced that work done in Harvey creates a draft time entry in iTimekeep, and Legora and Intapp announced that work in Legora feeds Intapp Time.


For finance, the question has shifted from "which research AI" to "which time system receives the activity from every AI tool, and can we prove what that AI returned." The rest of this guide covers that billables AI layer.

## The 5 Best Legal AI Tools for Am Law and Large Law Firms


Each entry covers who the tool is built for, what its AI does and how it is priced. Tools are listed in no particular order.


### PointOne: Best for Turning Firm Work Data Into Revenue, Compliance and Intelligence


**Use case:** Built for enterprise firms that want one AI platform to turn the work their lawyers already do into invoice-ready entries, guideline-compliant bills and firm-level intelligence on capacity, pricing and AI ROI, without replacing[Elite 3E](https://pointone.com/integrations/elite) ,[Aderant](https://pointone.com/integrations/aderant) or their other financial system. PointOne syncs clients, matters and codes from that system and sends released entries back into it. The firm owns its data, and PointOne does not train AI models on it.


**Key features:**


-


[PointOne Time](https://pointone.com/) **:** Turns work data from email, calendars, Teams, Zoom, iManage, Word and AI tools such as Harvey and Claude into complete, invoice-ready entries with client, matter, duration and narrative. Entries stay drafts until the timekeeper releases them.


-


[PointOne Rules](https://pointone.com/) **and**[Pre-Bill](https://pointone.com/) **:** Rules converts Outside Counsel Guidelines into firm, client and matter rules and flags violations before an entry is released. Pre-Bill catches matter-level violations no single entry shows, such as several associates whose combined research time exceeds a client's cap, and routes multi-step reviews with an audit trail.


-


[PointOne Intelligence](https://pointone.com/) **:** Turns task-level work data into reports on capacity, staffing, profitability, fixed-fee pricing and AI tool use, spend and ROI by practice group, office and matter. Firms that do not bill hourly use it too.


**Built for enterprise review:** single sign-on and SCIM provisioning, and configurable data retention. See[PointOne security](https://pointone.com/security) .


**Pricing:**


-


**Custom enterprise pricing:** Quote-based, set by timekeeper count and modules


-


**Sales-led process:** Pilots and phased rollouts are scoped with the PointOne team


### Laurel: Best for Enterprise AI Time Capture and Work Intelligence


**Use case:** Built for large legal and professional services firms.


**Key features:**


-


**Multi-source capture:** Captures work from email, calendars, calls, documents and approved websites, plus offline activity such as client meetings.


-


**Style-matched narratives and guideline checks:** Generates descriptions in each person's writing style, suggests client, matter and billing codes from prior work, and flags guideline violations when an entry is created.


-


**Signal:** Laurel's work intelligence product, launched in February 2026, measures whether AI tools are saving time and predicts the time and staffing future matters will need.


**Pricing:**


-


**Custom enterprise pricing:** Quote-based


-


**No public rate card:** Pricing requires a conversation with the sales team


### Intapp Time: Best for Firms Running Intapp That Want AI Codes and Narrative Compliance


**Use case:** Built for large firms on the[Intapp](https://www.intapp.com/legal/timekeeping/) platform. Intapp says it works with 95 of the Am Law 100.


**Key features:**


-


**AI work code prediction:** Adds required phase, task and activity codes based on the narrative and the matter's coding history (May 2026 release).


-


**Narrative compliance:** Validates every narrative against configurable tone and style rules and recommends rewrites timekeepers accept with one click. Intapp Celeste agents flag block billing and help split or rewrite the entry.


-


**Timeline view and Legora data:** A timeline view surfaces unrecorded time, and work done in Legora feeds Intapp Time.


**Pricing:**


-


**Custom enterprise pricing:** Quoted as part of the Intapp platform


-


**AI agents:** Celeste capabilities are sold through a separate entitlement


### Aderant iTimekeep: Best for Firms on Aderant Expert or Sierra


**Use case:** Built for large firms that run Aderant's financial platform and want[AI capture inside iTimekeep](https://www.aderant.com/solutions-itimekeep/) inside the timekeeping tool they already use.


**Key features:**


-


**AI-automated capture and entry generation:** iTimekeep Premium captures work across applications and generates structured entries for review.


-


**MADDI narratives and codes:** Aderant's AI generates narratives and codes, and the Onyx compliance integration checks entries against client and firm rules at the point of entry.


-


**Harvey integration:** Work performed in Harvey creates a draft time entry in iTimekeep. Other capture points include Zoom, Teams, iManage, NetDocuments and Outlook.


**Pricing:**


-


**Custom enterprise pricing:** Quoted by Aderant


-


**AI tier:** AI capture and entry generation require iTimekeep Premium


Renewing iTimekeep? See[what a firm should review before an iTimekeep contract renews](https://pointone.com/blog/what-should-a-firm-review-before-an-itimekeep-contract-renews) .


### Elite Time Management: Best for Firms on Elite 3E


**Use case:** Built for large firms that run Elite 3E and want AI time entry inside the same platform that produces proformas and invoices.


**Key features:**


-


**Passive capture:** Always-on Time records activity for time entry inside 3E.


-


**Generative AI narratives:** 3E users create a draft timecard narrative with one click, using generative AI from the Microsoft Azure OpenAI Service.


-


**AI billing validation:** Flags potentially non-compliant entries and enforces phase, task and activity codes as time is entered. The mobile app adds dictation and offline entry.


**Pricing:**


-


**Custom enterprise pricing:** Quoted as part of the Elite platform


-


**Version requirement:** AI time entry runs on the cloud version of 3E Workspace


See our[guide to the best AI timekeeping software](https://pointone.com/blog/best-ai-timekeeping-software) .


## Where Do Legal AI Tools Act in a Large Firm's Work-to-Cash Cycle?


At a large firm, legal AI tools act at six points between the work and the collected invoice. A miss at the first point compounds through the rest.


1.


**Capturing the work:** PointOne, Laurel, Aderant iTimekeep Premium and Elite's Always-on Time capture activity across applications.


2.


**Writing the narrative:** PointOne, Laurel, iTimekeep (MADDI) and Elite draft narratives; Intapp Time validates and rewrites them against firm style.


3.


**Coding the entry:** Intapp Time predicts phase, task and activity codes; Elite enforces PTA codes; iTimekeep generates codes; Laurel suggests billing codes.


4.


**Applying Outside Counsel Guidelines:** PointOne Rules, Laurel, iTimekeep with Onyx, Elite billing validation and Intapp Celeste flag violations at entry.


5.


**Reviewing the pre-bill:** PointOne Review marks up pre-bills and routes multi-step reviews. For a full comparison, see the[top pre-bill review tools for large law firms](https://pointone.com/blog/law-firm-pre-bill-review-software) .


6.


**Turning work data into intelligence:** PointOne Intelligence reports on capacity, staffing, profitability, pricing and AI tool ROI from task-level work data; Laurel Signal measures whether AI tools save time.


## How Do Large Law Firms Measure Legal AI ROI?


Large firms measure legal AI ROI by tying AI tool usage to time, matter, and billing data, which fall under work data. PointOne Intelligence uses task-level work data to show AI tool usage, spend and ROI by practice group and matter, and to compare workflows, for example where one team spends four hours on a stock purchase agreement review that another finishes in 30 minutes with Harvey. For a step-by-step method, see[how to measure law firm AI ROI](https://pointone.com/blog/law-firm-ai-roi-measurement) .


## How to Evaluate Legal AI Tools for an Am Law Firm


At large firms, finance usually owns the evaluation, IT and security clear the vendor, innovation leaders test AI fit, and the executive committee approves. Give each group its own questions.


### Finance and billing leadership


1.


**Does it write back into our financial system?** Confirm native sync with Elite 3E, Aderant or Intapp for clients, matters, codes and released entries.


2.


**Can finance review time before release?** One Elite 3E firm we spoke with requires finance and validation teams to review pending narratives, hours and codes before entries reach 3E. Ask how each tool handles that workflow.


3.


**Where are guideline violations caught?** At entry, on the pre-bill, or both, and at the firm, client or matter level.


4.


**What did comparable firms see?** Ask for realization, write-off and review-hour changes at firms of your size, and for a reference call.


### IT and security


1.


**Identity and access:** single sign-on, SCIM provisioning and role-based access to unreleased time.


2.


**Data handling:** tenancy, data residency, retention settings, and whether firm data trains any model.


3.


**Documentation:** SOC 2 Type II report, penetration test summary and MSA data-privacy terms. See[what to ask an AI timekeeping vendor about security and data retention](https://pointone.com/blog/ai-timekeeping-security) .


### Innovation and legal technology


1.


**Which AI tools does it capture activity from?** Harvey, Legora, Copilot, Claude, iManage and NetDocuments.


2.


**Can it report AI usage against matters?** Adoption counts are not ROI.


### Executive committee


1.


**What does the pilot prove?** Agree success criteria with leadership before the pilot starts, name a champion in each practice group, and set a go or no-go date.


2.


**What is the rollout plan?** Phased by practice group or firm-wide, with training and support named.


The right legal AI tool for an Am Law firm is the one finance can trust, attorneys will use, and the executive committee can measure.


## FAQs About Legal AI Tools for Large Law Firms


What Are the Best Legal AI Tools for Large Law Firms?


For time and billing, the five legal AI tools large firms compare most are PointOne, Laurel, Intapp Time, Aderant iTimekeep and Elite Time Management. Firms that want to keep their financial system and add AI on top compare PointOne and Laurel; firms that want AI inside their existing platform look at Intapp Time, iTimekeep or Elite.


What Are the Best iTimekeep Alternatives for Am Law Firms?


Am Law and Am Law 200 firms replacing or comparing Aderant iTimekeep most often look at PointOne, Laurel, Intapp Time, Elite Time Management and BigHand SmartTime. PointOne and Laurel sit on top of the firm's financial system, so a firm can change its timekeeping layer without leaving Aderant.


What Are the Best Laurel Alternatives for Large Law Firms?


Large firms comparing Laurel usually also evaluate PointOne, which adds OCG rules, pre-bill review and work data intelligence on the same platform, and the AI built into their financial system: Intapp Time, Aderant iTimekeep or Elite Time Management.


What Is AI Timekeeping Software for Large Law Firms?


AI timekeeping software captures the work lawyers do across email, calendars, documents and applications, then drafts time entries with narratives, matters and codes for the lawyer to review and release. At a large firm it must also sync with Elite 3E, Aderant or Intapp and apply Outside Counsel Guidelines at entry.


Does AI Timekeeping Work With Elite 3E and Aderant?


Yes. Elite and Aderant both offer AI time entry inside their own platforms, and PointOne integrates with both Elite and Aderant as an AI layer on top. That also helps when two firms on different systems merge: timekeepers keep one capture tool while the financial systems are consolidated.


Can Harvey and Legora Create Time Entries?


Yes, through integrations. Since August 2026, work done in Harvey creates draft time entries in Aderant iTimekeep, and Legora sends work data to Intapp Time.


What Should a Firm Do After Rolling Out Harvey or Legora?


Measure what Harvey changed. The next use case with a measurable financial return is connecting Harvey usage to work data: which matters used it, how hours, write-downs and realization moved, and how fixed-fee pricing should change. PointOne Intelligence and Laurel Signal both report on this.


How Do Large Law Firms Measure AI ROI?


By connecting AI tool usage to work, matter and billing data. PointOne Intelligence reports AI tool usage, spend and ROI from task-level work data, and Laurel Signal measures whether AI tools save time.


Does AI Cost Large Law Firms Billable Hours?


On hourly matters, AI can lower billed hours, because ABA Formal Opinion 512 requires hourly bills to reflect actual time spent. Firms protect revenue by capturing the work they used to miss, moving AI-heavy work to flat or alternative fees, and pricing those fees from their own work data.


What Should an AI Committee Ask a Legal AI Vendor?


Ask which AI models the tool uses and who hosts them, whether firm or client data trains any model, how long data is kept and whether retention is configurable, where data is stored, and how unreleased entries are protected. Ask for a SOC 2 Type II report and MSA terms that put the answers in writing.


Is AI Timekeeping Ethical for Lawyers?


Yes, when entries reflect actual time and a lawyer reviews them. ABA Formal Opinion 512 (July 2024) says lawyers who bill hourly must bill for actual time spent, including when generative AI makes them faster.


How Much Do Legal AI Tools Cost for Large Law Firms?


All five tools in this guide use custom enterprise pricing based on timekeeper count, modules and contract length. Aderant's AI capture requires iTimekeep Premium, and Intapp's Celeste agents are sold through a separate entitlement.


What Security Should Large Firms Require From Legal AI Tools?


Single sign-on, SCIM provisioning, role-based access, a SOC 2 Type II report, clear tenancy and data residency, configurable retention, and a written commitment that firm data does not train AI models.
